name: Subscription Cleaner
tagline: Bundles the forgotten mail, proposes what to cut, unsubscribes only your picks
description: Rounds up the mail you did not realize you had signed up for: receipts and newsletters get bundled, the subscriptions worth cutting are proposed with reasons, and nothing gets unsubscribed until you approve it. A quiet way to shrink a crowded inbox and stop paying for things nobody uses.
author: SpaceX
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
